title: 입천장 뒤로 훑기
instruction: 혀끝을 윗니 뒤에 댄 뒤 입천장을 따라 뒤로 천천히 움직이세요.
caption: 윗니 뒤에서 입천장을 따라 혀를 뒤로 움직이세요.
motion_prompt: Place the tongue tip directly behind the upper front teeth, then sweep the tongue backward along the roof of the mouth and lower it gently to the resting position.
face_animation_policy: 중립·목표·복귀의 얼굴 전체 자세를 먼저 설계한다. 운동에 필요한 턱·볼·입꼬리·턱선을 함께 연동하고 선화·명암·질감을 맞춘다. 정지 얼굴 위에 입 도형만 교체하는 방식은 사용하지 않는다. 혀 독립 운동의 턱 안정은 해당 운동 의도를 따른다.
poses: tongue TIP contacting alveolar ridge directly behind UPPER FRONT TEETH, broad tongue body curves naturally
tongue TIP curled and moved BACKWARD along the roof to the middle HARD PALATE; visible contact target behind previous pose, tongue body follows without penetrating palate
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Animation keyframe atlas for tongue_06_palate_sweep. EXACTLY 1 columns and 3 rows of equal rectangular 16:9 tiles, edge-to-edge, NO gaps, NO borders, NO labels. Overall aspect ratio 16:27. Read tiles row-major left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each tile contains ONE complete scene, not multiple views. Create a clean non-graphic clinical educational 2D illustration matching the warm cel-shaded palette of the reference. Neutral pale warm background, large isolated mouth anatomy, no extra therapist portrait or inset. Keep the exact SAME oral geometry, camera and scale across all tiles. Distinguish ivory teeth, pink gingiva and hard/soft palate, single pink muscular tongue. Clear natural contact surfaces, no intersection through teeth or roof. No gore, saliva or surgery. This is an illustrative draft for professional review. Stable SIDE SAGITTAL mouth cutaway facing VIEWER-LEFT: lips/front teeth at left, throat at right; upper/lower jaw, alveolar ridge, hard palate and posterior soft palate visible. Do not show a frontal view. Tile poses: TILE 1: tongue resting low inside mouth. TILE 2: tongue TIP contacting alveolar ridge directly behind UPPER FRONT TEETH, broad tongue body curves naturally. TILE 3: tongue TIP curled and moved BACKWARD along the roof to the middle HARD PALATE; visible contact target behind previous pose, tongue body follows without penetrating palate. Crucial: each pose must differ by the REQUESTED movement, not random expression. One tongue only, no extra teeth, no detached lips, no camera cuts, no text, numbers, arrows, captions, logos, watermark or UI.
